reason: The Industry combobox carries autocomplete="garbage", an invalid token, and the browser ignores it (the autocomplete property reads empty). Industry is a business category picked from a list, not one of the 1.3.5 input purposes, so the criterion does not cover this field and nothing about it is misidentified. The token only keeps browser autofill off the listbox, like autocomplete=off on its siblings.
criterionAnalysis: 1.3.5 Identify Input Purpose applies to fields that collect information about the user and serve a purpose in the WCAG input-purposes list (name, email, address, organization and so on). Industry has no token in that list, so there is no purpose to identify or misidentify, and F107 needs a value that contradicts a listed purpose. The field has an accessible name (Industry) and a role (combobox with a listbox popup), so 4.1.2 holds. WCAG 2.2 no longer has 4.1.1, so malformed attribute syntax is not a criterion. The sibling First name, Last name and Email fields are a separate matter and are not this finding.
